speaker: richard_burbage
text: From the shore. He is home from Ireland, and the power is gone, and I will not whisper a king.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You are fighting me, Richard. Bolingbroke is not a man you shout down. This scene is not a quarrel you can win.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will not have the roll in my hand. And I will not have Garnish in my ear.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I am at the book, and the book is shut until you ask. The pen is dry.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give me the long one again. No, don't read it, give it to me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For Gods sake let vs sit vpon the ground, and tell sad stories of the death of Kings.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Again. I had it in the throat and I spent it on the rafters.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Too loud. Thou art winning a fight that is not on the boards. A man cannot see the loss.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I can bear the noise. I would rather be handed a king who has already heard the news.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Louder is what a yard understands. Give it to me once more, and do not read it at me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Half the voice, and watch it all as if from a gallery seat, as if it were happening to someone you were sorry for.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sorry for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sorry for him. I am saying it low, for thee, not for the yard. The yard is not in this morning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will come in late, and I will not crow. If the scene needs a winning, I can stand there and be it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art a hard prompter. Stand out of the light and let me have the shore.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The shore is thine. Ireland behind thee. The power gone, before a word comes to explain it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have nothing to set in the margin. I am not keeping the loud pass.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Keep the margin empty. I am not done with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go again from the sit. Do not pace a loss as if it were a fight thou couldst win.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then hear it, Richard. I am not your enemy in the scene. I am the news.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have six lines after this, and I am afraid of each of them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold the roll if you must. Say them when we come to them. We are not at them yet.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Kemp is not called. I was not going to send for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. This morning is the king, and the cousin. Not a jig.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Clear the yard side. I want the boards, and no one feeding me the next sentence.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: From the shore, then. Come down to half, and I will meet you there.
